html:
KeysWhat they do
InsAdd a rung after the selected one
EnterEdit the selected rung as text
DelDelete the selected rung (or the selected tag in Controller Tags)
EscCancel the edit
↑ / ↓Select the previous / next rung
Ctrl+↑ / Ctrl+↓Move the rung up / down
Ctrl+DAdd or edit the comment on the selected rung
Enter / Shift+Enter / EscIn a comment: save / new line / cancel
Ctrl+C / Ctrl+XCopy / cut the selected instruction or branch (or the whole rung when nothing is selected)
Ctrl+V / Ctrl+Shift+VPaste after / before the selection, across rungs, routines, programs and projects
Ctrl+EnterIn a Structured Text routine: accept the text
TabIn a Structured Text routine: indent
Alt+3Open or close Quick Watch
Ctrl+ECross Reference for the selected instruction or tag
Ctrl+GGo To a routine and rung
Ctrl+F / F3 / Shift+F3Find / find next / find previous
Ctrl+HFind and Replace
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+YUndo / redo
Ctrl+TToggle the selected bit
Ctrl+S / Ctrl+OSave the project / open one
Ctrl+Shift+SSave As
Ctrl+PPut the selected parts on a panel
RRotate the selected part
Double-click a tabMaximize / restore the document
